task: perf: slowest local test step; open-tennis-robots lift-jam plant coupled step

doc_friction.issue: photo-editing and open-tennis-robots need PYTHONPATH=src to run pytest by hand; the cloud-session notes cover pyenv but not this, so the first timing run of photo-editing failed on import (run_venture_tests.py does set it).

notes: Metric: wall time of `PYTHONPATH=src python3.13 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_host.py -k LiftJam` in ventures/open-tennis-robots on this 4-core sandbox, quiet machine. Before: 36.6 s and 34.7 s (original lift_jam_sweep.py). After: 27.4 s (locals only), then 27.1 and 27.0 s (with abs/max replaced). Whole test_host.py went from 112.4 s to 105.4 s. Under cProfile, _step_coupled self time went from 43.9 s to 24.2 s. Verification: a scratch pytest plugin fed SHA-256 the repr of every numeric Plant attribute after each _step_coupled call, one digest per test. For old and new code across 2,915,000 calls in 7 tests, the JSON files were byte-identical (cmp). All 153 test_host tests pass. Survey: 341 node test files in einvoice-preflight, ids-model-check, sales-agent, xer-schedule-check and trade-bid-studio all ran in under 2 s each; photo-editing pytest took 118 s with no test over 8.5 s. Local checks: run_workflow_locally --for-changes ran pages.yml 6/6 run: steps ok and check_posts ok; the local ventures-tests run was stopped once PR CI (changed-ventures, open-tennis test and cad jobs, 16 of 16 non-skipped checks) went green.
